name: the-girls-trip-guide-native
description: Native iOS and Android shell for The Girls Trip Guide.

scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run native:push:install && npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-native-platforms.mjs && node scripts/configure-native-push.mjs
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run native:push:install && npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-native-platforms.mjs && node scripts/configure-native-push.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run native:push:install && npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync && node scripts/configure-native-platforms.mjs && node scripts/configure-native-push.mjs
scripts.mobile:copy: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap copy
